## Leadership Update: Meet Ankur Dewani


- by Skillz
- Oct. 21, 2026
- 2 min read


-
-
-
-


Ankur Dewani is CEO of Skillz India Platform Private Limited, which supports Skillz, the skill-based mobile gaming business of FIRY (NYSE: FIRY). A gamer and tech enthusiast with passion for all things that connect the two, he brings more than 15 years of experience building and scaling consumer gaming businesses, with a focus on retention-led growth, strong unit economics, and fast execution.


Before joining Skillz, Ankur co-founded Boom Games, an online gaming company he built from the ground up and led as CEO from 2022 to 2026. He grew the business to a peak annualized revenue run rate of approximately $25 million on approximately $2.4 million of net cash invested, and scaled the team to 65 people across Mumbai and Bengaluru. Under his leadership, Boom Games increased average revenue per user roughly eightfold, reached profitability, and went on to operate entirely on internal accruals.


Previously, Ankur served as CEO of PokerStars India, where he owned the full P&L and grew annual revenue while reducing customer acquisition costs by more than half. He expanded the India team from 3 people to 25 and made PokerStars the #2 poker brand in India by monthly active users and revenue. Before that, as PokerStars’ Country Manager for India, he led the first viable legal and operational structure for a global poker operator to launch in the country.


Earlier in his career, Ankur led commercial programs for major casino expansions as Vice President of Business Development and Commercials at Delta Corp, and served as COO of Poker Planet, one of India’s earliest poker businesses. He began his career in finance and M&A roles in New Zealand, India, and London.


Ankur holds a Master’s in Financial Management from IE Business School and a Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance from Auckland University of Technology. Outside of work, he builds AI tools that help teams move faster.
